# CLI: Database

## create-database-instance

Kind: Write.

Requires --yes. Creates one private, single-node MySQL 8.0 instance with automatic backup off, paid from credits through IAM Auto Payment. The `monthlyCost` of a flavor from `list-database-flavors` is a catalog estimate, not a quote; no quote API is available, so no price is checked before the charge. The instance name is 1 to 20 letters, digits, hyphens, or underscores, starting with a letter or digit. A 400 reply lists the rejected field names with sanitized messages, never the values sent. Choose every ID from the matching `list-database-*` catalog for one zone. The master password must be 8 to 32 characters of letters, digits, and `$ ^ _ < >`, start with a letter, and end with a letter or digit; it is checked before any request. It comes only from `--password-file`, a private file or `-` for stdin, and never from argv, JSON input, or the environment. The create is sent once and never resent. It waits up to 30 minutes for ACTIVE; `--no-wait` returns after the request is accepted. On NotSettled or WriteFailed the partial output on stdout holds the instance ID when one is known; inspect inventory and billing before another mutation. Deleting does not promise a refund.

| Flag | Type | Required |
|-|-|-|
| `--name` | `string` | yes |
| `--zone-id` | `string` | yes |
| `--flavor-id` | `int` | yes |
| `--storage-type-id` | `string` | yes |
| `--storage-size` | `int` | yes |
| `--vpc-id` | `string` | yes |
| `--subnet-id` | `string` | yes |
| `--database-name` | `string` | yes |
| `--username` | `string` | yes |
| `--no-wait` | `bool` |  |
| `--password-file` | `string` |  |

```sh
vngcloud database create-database-instance --name <name> --zone-id <zone-id> --flavor-id <flavor-id> --storage-type-id <storage-type> --storage-size <gb> --vpc-id <vpc-id> --subnet-id <subnet-id> --database-name <database> --username <user> --password-file <path> --yes
```

## delete-database-instance

Kind: Write, destructive.

Requires --yes. Refuses, sending nothing, unless the instance is an ACTIVE MySQL instance that is not shared with no backups and no replicas. Sends no final backup and no backup purge, and waits up to 30 minutes for confirmed absence; `Deleted` is true only after that. Deleting does not promise a refund. On NotSettled the partial output holds the instance ID; inspect inventory and billing before another mutation.

| Flag | Type | Required |
|-|-|-|
| `--id` | `string` | yes |

```sh
vngcloud database delete-database-instance --id <id> --yes
```
